install: set -euo pipefail; if ! .venv/bin/python3 -c 'import sys' >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m venv --clear .venv; fi; .venv/bin/python3 -m pip install --no-input -r requirements-lock.txt; touch ~/.bashrc; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; EXPORT_LINE="export PATH=\"$(pwd)/.venv/bin:\$PATH\""; grep -qxF "$EXPORT_LINE" ~/.bashrc || echo "$EXPORT_LINE" >> ~/.bashrc
